mechanisms.confirmationBias: Asymmetric weighting of new information conditional on an observable prior stance. Evidence exposure must be verified; persistence alone is insufficient.
mechanisms.beliefPerseverance: Observable prior stance persists after the original evidentiary basis is explicitly corrected, withdrawn, or invalidated, with verified exposure to that correction.
mechanisms.conservatism: Belief moves in the direction of valid new information but by less than a pre-specified update benchmark. Price underreaction alone is insufficient.
